items.name: Spec Compliance
items.note: AC1-AC11 implemented. Small deviations, all disclosed: invalid-submit toast text follows the design ("Bitte korrigieren Sie die markierten Felder."); reset also clears the problem summary and field errors; suggestions with several house numbers show them as a "Nr. …" line instead of chips; iframe title now German; shared touches recorded in Design Notes: .dark color-scheme, Label line-height, viewport-fit=cover; one assertion added to the dark-theme e2e spec. Not done: the design's 32px icon circle in toasts and a custom calendar icon (the native date-picker icon stays) — cosmetic, listed as follow-ups.

items.name: Error Handling
items.note: Generation errors still toast as before; a generation counter drops results that finish after a reset; isGenerating cleared in finally and on reset; sheet open state derived from snapshot + phone width so it cannot show an empty or stale sheet.

items.name: Security Basics
items.note: No new network calls; privacy note matches the data flow (only the entered address via the own service); new dependency @radix-ui/react-dialog (MIT, same Radix family already used).

items.name: Test Quality
items.note: Unit tests written first for helpers, components and page (busy state via deferred promise, phone sheet via matchMedia override, snapshot after edits); e2e spec written after the implementation, not test-first; the fixed-colour guard test was added after the cleanup. Mocks only at boundaries (fetch, PDF service).

items.name: Performance Basics
items.note: Main bundle 301.8 kB (94.7 kB gzip) after adding Radix Dialog, which shares most dependencies with the existing dropdown menu. No PDF frame is mounted on phones until the sheet opens.

items.name: Naming & Structure
items.note: Page split into AppHeader, PrivacyNote, PreviewPanel, PdfSheet, PdfActionButtons; helpers in lib (invoiceTotal, pdfActions, recipient); all files ≤ 206 lines; print/save code moved verbatim.

items.name: Affected Boundaries
items.note: No storage key, serialized format, env or API contract changed; PDF generator files untouched.
